claims.claim_text: Thomas J Coleman has a confirmed match to the exact name and private identifier in the official Army merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The indexed identifier selects one of twenty exact-name Army rows and dates Army entry to 31 March 1941 as a private.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier disambiguates the selected row from the other exact-name Army records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The record dates Army entry but does not identify a later unit, OSS start or pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: The matched private grade supports enlisted Army classification. The identifier remains private.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies Lawrence A Coleman, a six-digit identifier, no rank and Box 134. The Army file has one exact-name row with a different identifier; the short printed value was not padded or assigned to that candidate.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 134 to determine Lawrence A Coleman's identifier system, personnel status, occupation, employer and OSS assignment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies Marion E Coleman, no rank or identifier and Box 134. One exact-name Army row and broad public candidates lack corroborating OSS or Box evidence.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 134 to establish Marion E Coleman's full identity, personnel status, occupation, employer and OSS assignment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies Robert C Coleman, a seven-digit identifier, no rank and Box 135. Eighteen exact-name Army rows and broad public candidates remain undifferentiated; the short value was not padded.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 135 to determine Robert C Coleman's identifier system and distinguish the many name matches before testing employers.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact indexed private identifier selects one of twenty official Army rows named Thomas J Coleman. It dates Army entry to 31 March 1941 as a private and carries civilian-occupation code 125.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 135 and pre-March 1941 directories to identify Thomas J Coleman's actual machine, employer and Army-to-OSS sequence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies William S Coleman, no rank or identifier and Box 135. Seven exact-name Army rows and broad public candidates provide no corroborating OSS or Box linkage.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 135 to establish William S Coleman's identifiers, personnel status, occupation, employer and OSS assignment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies Aline J Colgate, no rank or identifier and Box 135. Exact-name OSS, institutional, newspaper, obituary and archival searches did not produce a corroborated identity or employer.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 135 to establish Aline J Colgate's full identity, personnel status, occupation, employer and OSS assignment.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index identifies Orrin K Coligan as a sergeant in Box 135. One exact-name Army row and a postwar news-photo caption are plausible but lack the identifier or personnel-file bridge needed to connect them to the index row.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 135 to confirm Orrin K Coligan's service identity, Army chronology, pre-service occupation and employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact indexed private identifier selects the official Army row named Ioannis N Collaros, a documented variant of the index's printed Loannis N Collaros. It dates Army entry to 3 April 1942 as a private and carries civilian-occupation code 061.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 135 and pre-April 1942 directories to identify Collaros's actual radio work, employer and Army-to-OSS sequence.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The uncommon Joseph Collart name and direct Area B context align; official sources supply middle initial H, Captain grade and Washington State association that the index omits. person_updates.next_action: Review Box 135 to establish Norman T Collett's full identity, personnel status, occupation, employer and OSS assignment.

research_attempts.next_action: Determine the identifier system and full identity in Box 134.
